pages.title: Boarders from the Deep
paragraphs: Bartz's pirates lie broken on the deck, and Bartz himself is in irons at Maria's mercy. But the sea is not finished with either of them.
In the dead of night, wet shapes claw over the rails: fishlike men with glassy eyes and barbed spears. Their raid does not care whose ship this is.
Maria frees Bartz. Their quarrel can wait: they will fight side by side until they reach {island}, where Maria will hand him over to the authorities.

pages.title: Bartz Joins the Party
paragraphs: Bartz is now under your command. Select him like any other unit, and press Tab to cycle between your units.
Maria and Bartz each start this chapter with a Potion. Use it from the Inventory menu on a wounded unit.

pages.title: Axes Beat Spears
paragraphs: The Merfolk fight with Spears, and Bartz wields an Axe. Axes beat Spears, so Bartz gains {hit} Hit and {avoid} Avoid and deals {damage} more damage against them.
Maria's Rapier is a Sword, and Spears beat Swords. Let Bartz take the Merfolk head-on, and keep Maria for finishing blows.
